stories.title: Replacing Webpack with Vite
stories.situation: The frontend build and feedback cycle was slow in a healthcare consent platform.
stories.task: Modernize the build tooling without disrupting the existing application.
stories.action: Replaced Webpack with Vite and adapted the project and CI workflow.
stories.result: GitHub Actions build time decreased from 8 minutes to 2 minutes.

stories.title: Testing Healthcare Administration Workflows
stories.situation: A complex healthcare administration UI required cross-application integration coverage.
stories.action: Used CodeceptJS with Playwright, including CI-aware waits and trace capture.
stories.tradeoffs: The older abstraction reduced direct Playwright control but provided readable scenario APIs.
needsReview: Describe one defect caught or regression prevented

stories.title: Turning Repeated Shopify Support Work into a Reusable Library
stories.situation: Recurring Shopify theme and app integration problems required similar JavaScript and Liquid fixes.
stories.task: Reduce repetition and make solutions easier for support developers to reuse.
stories.action: Designed and documented reusable integration helpers and patterns.
stories.result: Improved consistency and reduced repeated investigation; the previously claimed 30% reduction needs verification.
stories.tradeoffs: A generalized library required careful compatibility handling across merchant themes.

stories.title: Building Product Discovery beyond Traditional Liquid Rendering
stories.situation: A large BBQ catalog needed interactive filtering, comparison, and guided product discovery.
stories.task: Create richer client-side product experiences than the existing Liquid theme supported.
stories.action: Built Web Component interfaces backed by Shopify Storefront GraphQL APIs and administration workflows.
stories.result: Delivered real-time catalog interactions and merchant tooling; the 40% maintenance metric needs verification.
stories.tradeoffs: A JavaScript-heavy storefront improved interactivity but increased frontend state and integration complexity.

stories.title: Modeling Research Consent with FHIR Shorthand
stories.situation: Research consent required reusable and interoperable FHIR definitions.
stories.task: Contribute profiles, extensions, value sets, and usable consent interfaces.
stories.action: Authored FSH/SUSHI artifacts and contributed React/Next.js and LHC-Forms interfaces.
stories.result: Created reusable research consent artifacts and contributed to academic work.
stories.tradeoffs: FHIR conformance, research requirements, and user-friendly data capture had to be balanced.

stories.title: Consent-Aware EHR-to-EHR Transfer with SMART on FHIR
stories.situation: A demonstration needed to launch from an EHR, retrieve patient data, apply privacy decisions, and transfer allowed resources.
stories.task: Implement the application flow and make the multi-service environment deployable.
stories.action: Built SMART launch and patient-context handling, processed FHIR bundles, integrated consent/privacy services, and automated Fly.io deployment.
stories.result: Produced a working interoperability demonstration across source and target environments.
stories.tradeoffs: Using Medplum accelerated the demo, while browser-held credentials and deployment secrets required later security cleanup.
needsReview: Complete security cleanup before public promotion

stories.title: Designing Reliable Multi-Step Background Work in BullMQ
stories.situation: AI-assisted language analysis and session completion could not reliably run inside a single request.
stories.task: Move work to queues while reducing duplicate downstream analysis.
stories.action: Used BullMQ workers, schema-validated payloads, deterministic job IDs, database state checks, and worker failure logs.
stories.result: Separated request handling from long-running work and created a basis for retryable processing.
stories.tradeoffs: Partial failure, transcript persistence idempotency, retry policy, and dead-letter handling still need deeper tests.
needsReview: Add explicit backoff and dead-letter strategy
Measure job latency and failure rates

stories.title: Security Review of a Shopify OAuth Library Built in 2020
stories.situation: Next.js Shopify applications needed reusable authorization and session middleware.
stories.task: Implement OAuth start, callback, HMAC validation, state/nonce protection, and authenticated API access.
stories.action: Built next-connect-shopify and later reviewed it against current security and framework expectations.
stories.result: Created reusable integration code and a concrete security-learning artifact.
stories.tradeoffs: The current code has outdated dependencies and correctness issues, including domain validation, error classification, async handling, and module-level mutable state.
needsReview: Add threat model and automated tests

stories.title: Planned Career Break and Return to Canada
stories.situation: The Shift contract ended in June 2025 while major marriage, family, and relocation commitments required time abroad.
stories.task: Complete the family transition and return to Canada ready for long-term work.
stories.action: Took a planned break from July 2025 through June 2026 and continued technical learning and project work where appropriate.
stories.result: Returned to Canada in July 2026 and became available for long-term full-time roles.
